subject: UiPath looks for a path to growth with Peak agentic AI
object: A rush of agentic AI solutions is hitting the enterprise market, and now one of the bigger players in automation has scooped up a startup in the space in hopes of taking a bigger piece of that market. UiPath , as part of a quarterly result report last night that spelled tougher times ahead, also delivered what it hopes might prove a silver lining. It said it had acquired Peak.ai , a startup founded originally in Manchester, England.

subject: UiPath looks for a path to growth with Peak agentic AI
object: Peak could potentially help its new owner bolster revenue growth. The two companies already had partnerships prior to the acquisition, and the idea is that the deal will give UiPath more opportunities to cross-sell its wider set of solutions to Peak’s customers, as well as capture more of Peak’s overall revenue.

subject: UiPath looks for a path to growth with Peak agentic AI
object: “The ability to seamlessly integrate decision intelligence with automation presents an unprecedented opportunity to redefine how businesses operate,” Peak’s three founders, Richard Potter (CEO), David Leitch (CIO) and Atul Sharma (CTO), said in a message today announcing the acquisition.

subject: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei 发文澄清：公司从未主张禁止
object: 今天，Anthropic 的 CEO Dario Amodei 终于坐不住了，在官方发布一篇《我们对开放权重模型的立场》的文章，表示许多科技公司签署了支持开放权重模型的声明，甚至有人指责 Anthropic 试图通过禁止开放权重模型来保护自己的业务利益。

subject: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei 发文澄清：公司从未主张禁止
object: Dario Amodei 表示，那些没有危险功能的开放权重模型是一种公共资产：它们除了运行所需的计算资源外不会造成任何成本，同时还能为企业、开发者以及研究人员带来价值。
